title: Website Security Renewal Terms and the Expired-Plan Grace Period
content:
## 1. When a renewal may be charged

A renewal of a Harborline SiteGuard plan may be charged only while the plan status is active or expired.

| Plan status | Renewal may be charged |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Expired | Yes, subject to clause 4 |
| Pending setup | No |
| Cancel pending | No |
| Cancelled | No |

## 2. Price and term of a renewal

A renewal is billed at the price for the renewal term with the discount basis of Website Security pricing on the renewal date: the term price of the tier for the renewal term, reduced by the higher of the product's hosted-site discount percentage (counted only when the site is then on an active Harborline hosting plan) and the website security discount percentage of the customer's account tier on that date, the two never added, rounded half up to the cent. The new term starts on the previous term end date, and its end date is the new term start plus the renewal term in calendar months. The renewal is billed as one renewal or auto-renew charge covering the previous term end to the new term end.

## 3. Auto-renewal

Where auto-renew is on, the renewal is charged the tier's set number of days before the term end date (the days before the term end on which the renewal is charged, 7 on every Harborline SiteGuard tier).

## 4. Renewing an expired plan

An expired plan may be renewed only on or before the expired date plus the tier's expired grace days, in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the expired date, counting the next day as day 1, and the last day is included. The expired date is the date shown on the plan's record, and the comparison is made against the system record, not against a date the customer states. After the last day of the window the expired plan may not be renewed under this clause. Renewing an expired plan returns it to active, and its expired date is cleared.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, grace days 15)

| Expired date shown on the plan | Day 1 of the window | Last day of the window | Renewal on the 17th | Renewal on the 18th |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| The 2nd of a month | The 3rd | The 17th | Within the window | Outside the window |

A renewal on the last day, the 17th, qualifies because the last day is included; a renewal on the following day does not.
